Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Time, the calendar & feasts

in the afternoon phrase

also afternoon, p.m., this afternoon

classical

Cic. Tusc. 2.9 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 81

post merīdiem

in the afternoon, p.m.

English p.m. is short for it.

Other words

  • pōmerīdiānus (postmerīdiānus), pōmerīdiāna, pōmerīdiānum — of the afternoon; after an hour, p.m.

    adjective · also used · classical · Traupman 81: prīma hōra postmerīdiāna; Cic. de Or. 3.17: pōmerīdiānum tempus (Lewis & Short)

    Lewis & Short’s headword; Cicero preferred pō- to post- (Orat. 157, quoted there).

Examples

  • Est prīma hōra post merīdiem.

    It’s one p.m.Traupman 81

  • hodiē post merīdiem

    this afternoonTraupman 269

See also before noon, noon, hour.
